Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity testing.
